title: Safety Training - Rice/Correa Lab
author: Samantha R Coy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba8xihxn

steps.title: Register for Safety Training
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Rice University Environmental Health Safety Training Schedule and Registration Page to sign up for required courses.

steps.title: Complete Required Safety Courses
steps.instruction: Complete the General Laboratory Safety Training and the Biosafety and Bloodborne Pathogens Safety Training based on your previous training status.

substeps.instruction: If first-time: Attend both sessions in person. Contact cmize@rice.edu if training is needed sooner than available courses.
If returning: Complete the online refresher courses for both sessions via the Canvas Dashboard using Rice netID credentials.

steps.title: Document Safety Certifications
steps.instruction: Process the safety certification files received after completing the in-person or online refresher courses.

substeps.instruction: Print out the certification files for each course.
Obtain signatures on the documents from both yourself and Dr. Correa.
Place the signed certifications in the Safety Certification binder.

steps.title: Schedule Lab-Specific Safety Training
steps.instruction: Contact the person in charge of safety in the Correa Lab (currently Dr. Amanda Shore, ashore@rice.edu) to schedule lab safety training.

substeps.instruction: Undergo training to familiarize yourself with lab equipment locations, including the first-aid kit and eye-wash stations.
